acceptance: Root cause of each failure named in the PR, with the commit that introduced it
Both cells pass in the UAT harness (local docker or a dispatched trunk UAT run; run link recorded)
A regression test at the loader boundary for each cause

context:
Found by trunk UAT calibration on 2026-11-06. Evidence artifacts: release-uat-trunk-525361b2f8b97f8d750b2faaab8d3f9f3a750d2e-stage3-olap and -stage3-postgres-family (cells.jsonl, per-cell logs). Heavy runs only through lock-taking entry points. DECISION GATE: any change to Doris load strictness or filter ratio goes to the owner.

Progress 2026-11-06 (local UAT reproduction, Apple container/mocker on macOS arm64, develop c2bdd8bc67):
- doris clickbench SF0.01: REPRODUCED with the harness (make uat-cell, Doris 4.0.3-all-slim started from the compose entrypoint script via `container run`; mocker compose cannot start the Doris FE here: entrypoint override ignored, FE gets -Xmx8g). Same `[DATA_QUALITY_ERROR] Encountered unqualified data` as CI. Root cause: Stream Load columns header maps every field with nullif(tmp_i,'') regardless of the dialect null marker; ClickBench writes empty strings as "" and NULL as __NULL__, so with trim_double_quotes every empty string became NULL and hits NOT NULL columns rejected all rows. Introduced by 9d675b4038 (#3949, perf(doris): stream TPC files as-is and null empty fields server-side). Fix: nullif against dialect.null_marker (commit on branch fix/doris-clickbench-mooncake-flightdata-load). After fix: doris clickbench, flightdata, tpch, datavault, nyctaxi SF0.01 all pass locally. No strict mode / max_filter_ratio / validation change.
- pg-mooncake flightdata SF0.01: NOT reproduced locally. Passed standalone, in the CI cell order (all 0.01 cells before it incl. metadata_primitives, minus joinorder 1.0), and 3x re-run in the same container (DB drop/recreate path). #3949/#3950 cannot change the loaded bytes: prepare_local_load_file output for flights.csv.zst is byte-identical to the pre-#3949 per-line rewrite, and #3950 does not touch the PostgreSQL path. SQL/DDL/docker image digest unchanged between the 0.5.0 and trunk UAT runs. The CI failure is inside Moonlink (replication channel closed during mooncake.create_table of flights); the re-run signature (staging table present, flights/airlines empty, `flights already exists` on restore) points to state left by the first (quiet, unlogged) attempt, whose error is not in the evidence.
